passages.text: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased; for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.
passages.note: Envy of others' wealth; what lasts

passages.text: Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions. Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin. For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.

Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me. Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your holy Spirit from me. Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
passages.note: Wanting a fresh start after wrongdoing

passages.text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. A broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.
passages.note: Brokenness and remorse are accepted, not despised

passages.text: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me. Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me. I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest. Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.
passages.note: Overwhelming fear and the wish to escape

passages.text: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him. But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend. We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.
Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
passages.note: Carrying a heavy burden; letting it go

passages.text: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you. In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your bottle. Aren’t they in your book?
passages.note: Sorrow that feels unseen is noticed

passages.text: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.
passages.note: Sheltering until a hard time passes
